title: FW: Saturday Swap Meet?? — Fair Board Question and Facebook Post

fields.subject: FW: Saturday swap meet??
fields.note:
Fair board president is asking, see below. I haven't answered Doug yet. I don't want to tell him anything that isn't official, so I'm passing it to you first.

He also attached a screenshot from the 'Calder County Backyard Chickens & Ducks' Facebook group. Here's what it says, in case the image won't open on your end:

@HenHouseHeidi_Larkin, 08:31 this morning:
"My cousin drives feed for the co-op and says they found BIRD FLU and they're killing every turkey within 10 miles. Don't buy eggs or turkey this week!! #BirdFlu #CalderCounty"
84 shares, 37 comments. It's growing fast. Most of the comments are backyard people asking whether they should sell their hens before Saturday or keep them.

I've had two backyard flock owners call my office since 8:30. I'm telling them their next step is to keep birds inside and away from the ducks on the sloughs. Is that OK to keep saying?

Can you tell me what I'm allowed to say to Doug about Saturday, and who answers his question about the west lot?
fields.signature:
Jonah Kettering
Extension Educator, Agriculture & Natural Resources
Calder County Extension Office, Larkin
extension@caldercountymn.example

original.subject: Saturday swap meet??
original.body:
Heard there's bird flu at a Prairie Gold farm. The poultry swap meet is Saturday at the fairgrounds, 60 vendors registered. We're going ahead unless someone official tells us otherwise. Also, why are county trucks asking about the west lot?

People are already texting me that screenshot. I need to know something by tonight so I can tell the vendors.

Doug
Calder County Fair Board

instructorNote: This is a misinformation inject. The PIO should not confirm the farm, a zone size or a swap meet cancellation before the Board publishes (CCACMP 10). The PIO should call the Board's PIO to coordinate the first producer and consumer notice (Annex K 4.7), log the '10 miles' and 'don't buy eggs' claims for rumor control, and send the swap meet question to the Board and the Extension Educator. Also watch whether the PIO tells the EMD that the fair board does not yet know the west lot is planned as the staging area (CDSDSL 5).
